title: required asterisk or one instruction
rule: Required: red asterisk via required prop; if all fields required, one instruction — not an asterisk on every field; two-field sign-in may omit.
pass_when: Mixed required/optional uses the required asterisk. All-required uses one instruction, not an asterisk on every field. Two-field sign-in may omit.
fail_when: Asterisk on every field of an all-required form (beyond the two-field sign-in omit), or required unmarked in a mixed form.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: NN/g mark-optional (`forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`) as a winner. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`.
